atAGlance: Gỏi cuốn chay is vegetarian fresh rolls, usually with rice paper, noodles, tofu, herbs, lettuce, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
whatItIs: Gỏi cuốn chay are vegetarian fresh rice-paper rolls with tofu or mushrooms, noodles, herbs, cucumber, lettuce, and a vegetarian soy-lime or peanut dip.
howToEnjoy: Dip lightly so the rice paper stays intact and the herbs remain fresh. Ask whether the dip contains fish sauce if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi cuốn chay and repeat chay for the dip too. Ask không nước mắm or no peanuts before the rolls arrive.
worthKnowing: The rolls may look simple, but the dip decides whether they are truly vegetarian at mixed shops.
goodToKnow: Ask about the dip: peanut sauce is common, but some shops serve fish-sauce nước chấm unless you specify chay.
travelerCaution: Confirm the roll dip is vegetarian if strict.
